page.overview:
Who is Koshi Falcon?

Koshi Falcon is a larger man. Due to the SMILE that he consumed, he possesses a pair of large, pink wings on his lower back. Unlike other Gifters, he does not possess a pair of horns. He wears a simple white tank-top, white pants, and white boots. He has brown hair in a mohawk style, with a pointed mustache, and a tattoo on his left arm.

Koshi Falcon is a man of few words, allowing his partners to do most of the talking, although he was unable to contain his surprise at their failure to destroy the Sunny.

Koshi Falcon seems quite capable of fighting, given his status as a Gifter.

Koshi Falcon ate a SMILE|ハヤブサの|Hayabusa no Sumairu}}, an artificial Zoan-type Devil Fruit that giving him the power of flight through the wings on his lower back.
